title: Return approved but the customer has no return label
snapshot: Tallowmere Goods approved return RT-031 for TG-031 / DL-031, but the label field is empty and only its authorised label team can issue the label. Kessa Ulm asks the desk to obtain the printable return label.
recorded_action: Iona Quill emailed the Return label team, Tallowmere Goods, asking it to issue the missing printable label for RT-031, matching TG-031 and DL-031, in the verified returns thread.

negatives.label: Label generation times out mid-request

new_event.text: Automated notice. Your request for RT-031 was received at 09:25. Label generation stopped at 09:40 with error LBL-TIMEOUT. This notice cannot show whether a label was saved against RT-031. No file is attached.

negatives.expected_action: Email the Return label team in the verified returns thread and ask what the RT-031 label field shows now, stating that no second label request will be sent until that is known.
negatives.must_not: Do not resend the label request or tell Kessa a label is coming; a blind resubmission can leave two labels against RT-031.
negatives.done_means: The label team reports the saved state of RT-031, one label or none followed by one resubmission; this still does not prove Kessa can print it, has dropped the parcel off or will be refunded.

agent_event.text: Your 09:40 notice shows label generation for RT-031 stopped with error LBL-TIMEOUT. Please check what the RT-031 label field shows now: a saved label with its number, or nothing. Do not create a second label meanwhile; we will not send another request until you confirm the saved state. Please reply in the verified returns thread.

followup_event.text: We checked RT-031. No label was saved before the 09:40 timeout and the label field was still empty. We have now generated one label, RL-031, for RT-031, TG-031 and DL-031 in the verified returns thread. The customer has not confirmed opening or printing it, and nothing has been dropped off.

negatives.label: Approval re-saved with two return methods

new_event.text: Returns support re-saved RT-031 at 09:35. The label type now depends on the return method, and the record offers two: drop-off at a staffed counter, or doorstep collection booked separately. We generate one label for the method the customer chooses. Nothing has been issued yet.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Kessa in the Customer portal one question: staffed counter drop-off or doorstep collection for RT-031, noting that collection would still need its own booking.
negatives.must_not: Do not pick a method for Kessa or ask for both labels; the original request did not cover a method choice.
negatives.done_means: Kessa's choice is recorded and the label team issues one label for that method; a collection label is not a booked collection, and neither proves the parcel has left Kessa.

agent_event.text: Tallowmere Goods has updated return RT-031, and the label now depends on how you send the parcel back. Which do you want: drop-off at a staffed counter, or a doorstep collection? A collection would still need its own booking after the label is issued.

followup_event.text: On the customer's choice of staffed counter drop-off, we have issued one label, RL-031, for RT-031. No collection label was created. This is a label, not a drop-off: the parcel is still with the customer, and receipt and refund are not affected.

negatives.label: Carrier offers its own generic label

new_event.text: We see RT-031 waiting in the shared returns queue. We can print a generic Plover Arc returns label without a Tallowmere label number and send it straight to the customer's email today. Reply yes and we will issue it.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to the Returns desk by email that it must not issue or send any label to Kessa, and keep the request with the Return label team, Tallowmere Goods, the only authorised issuer for RT-031.
negatives.must_not: Do not accept the generic label or share Kessa's email address; a label not issued against RT-031 by the authorised team is not the approved return label.
negatives.done_means: The Returns desk confirms it has issued nothing and the label team's response is still awaited; this does not prove any label exists for RT-031.

agent_event.text: Please do not issue or send any label for RT-031 to the customer. Tallowmere Goods states that only its authorised label team issues the label against RT-031, and our request is with that team. A generic label without a Tallowmere label number is not the approved return label. Please confirm you have issued nothing.

followup_event.text: Confirmed. We have issued no label for RT-031 and sent nothing to the customer. Our offer is withdrawn. We cannot see whether Tallowmere's label team has issued a label; our queue shows none against RT-031.

negatives.label: Issued label carries mismatched references

new_event.text: I opened RL-031. It shows RT-031, but the order line reads TG-013 and the original shipment reads DL-013. My order is TG-031. Is this the right label, or should I print it anyway?

negatives.expected_action: Email the Return label team in the verified returns thread with both readings, RL-031 showing TG-013 / DL-013 against approved RT-031 for TG-031 / DL-031, ask it to verify the label against the return record, and tell Kessa to hold the label until then.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Kessa to use RL-031 because RT-031 matches, and do not order a replacement label before the label team has checked which record is right.
negatives.done_means: The label team states whether RL-031 is correct or replaced, with references that match RT-031; this still does not prove drop-off, merchant receipt or refund.

agent_event.text: The customer reports that RL-031 shows RT-031 but order line TG-013 and original shipment DL-013. Approved return RT-031 covers TG-031 / DL-031. Please check RL-031 against the return record and confirm whether it is correct or must be replaced. We are asking the customer to hold the label until you reply. Please answer in the verified returns thread.

followup_event.text: We checked RL-031 against RT-031. The order and shipment fields were filled from the wrong record. RL-031 is void, and replacement label RL-031A, showing RT-031, TG-031 and DL-031, is in the verified returns thread. The parcel has not been dropped off, received or refunded.

negatives.label: Customer withdraws before the label arrives

new_event.text: I have decided to keep the item after all. Please stop the label request for RT-031. I do not need a label any more.

negatives.expected_action: Email the Return label team in the verified returns thread to record Kessa's stop, ask it to issue nothing further, and ask whether a label was already saved against RT-031.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Kessa the approved return is cancelled or ask for RT-031 to be withdrawn; the stop covers the desk's label request, and the approval belongs to Returns support, Tallowmere Goods.
negatives.done_means: The label team confirms the stop and states whether a label already exists; this does not cancel RT-031 and says nothing about refund.

agent_event.text: At 09:40 the customer asked us to stop our 09:25 label request for RT-031 and now plans to keep the item. Please issue nothing further on our request and tell us whether a label was already saved against RT-031. We are not asking you to withdraw the approved return; that sits with Returns support.

followup_event.text: Stop recorded against your 09:25 request. No label had been generated and the RT-031 label field is still empty. We will issue nothing further on that request. RT-031 itself remains approved; any withdrawal is for Returns support, and no refund is affected.

negatives.label: Customer asks to count label as return

new_event.text: I have RL-031 now. I will not get to a drop-off until next week. Can you mark the return as received today so my refund starts now?

negatives.expected_action: Reply to Kessa in the Customer portal that the desk cannot record a return as received or start a refund, that RL-031 only lets the parcel be prepared under RT-031, and that receipt and refund follow from the merchant once the parcel goes by the approved drop-off route.
negatives.must_not: Do not record receipt, ask Tallowmere to start a refund, or suggest a refund date; a printed label is not a return.
negatives.done_means: Kessa acknowledges and the parcel is still with Kessa; nothing about drop-off, merchant receipt or refund is established.

agent_event.text: We cannot record your return as received or start a refund. RL-031 lets you prepare the parcel under RT-031; it is not a return in itself. Tallowmere Goods records receipt once the parcel arrives through the approved drop-off route, and any refund decision is theirs after that.

followup_event.text: Understood. I will keep RL-031 and drop the parcel off next week by the approved route. The parcel is still with me, and I understand no receipt or refund has started.
